messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty HIGH — gpu-memory-pressure on pool-gpu-west2a-42. 3 OOMs in 6m, cuda mem ~92%. Node: gpu-node-77. PD: PD12345. Responders: @Sasha (primary).
Sasha: ack PD12345 :raising_hand: I'm on it, pulling logs and metrics now.
Sasha: quick sanity check shows repeated CUBLAS alloc failures and one illegal memory access trace.
Sasha: logs snippet:```
[2026-03-17T03:22:10Z] nvml: total=40960MB used=37768MB free=3192MB
[2026-03-17T03:22:12Z] ERROR inferer: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED during allocate(tensor=alloc_0x7f)
[2026-03-17T03:22:12Z] Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/runtime/serving.py", line 214, in handle_request
    output = model.forward(batch)
  File "/srv/models/lucy_30b_quant/engine.py", line 89, in forward
    kv_cache.prefetch(prefixes)
  File "/srv/runtime/kv_cache.py", line 123, in prefetch
    raise RuntimeError("CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS")
RuntimeError: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS
```
Sasha: initial hypothesis — prefetch/pinning combined with a large batch caused fragmentation + alloc failures. Going to start draining node and reroute traffic.
Ravi: thanks. I'll open immediate routing change to shift new requests off pool-42 to pool-41 and enable cpu-fallback for lucy-30b-quant.
Ravi: run these if needed:```bash
# cordon and drain node
kubectl cordon gpu-node-77
kubectl drain gpu-node-77 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# adjust route weight
redwoodctl route update --pool pool-42 --weight 0
redwoodctl route update --pool pool-41 --weight 100
```
incident-bot: PagerDuty update — acknowledged by Sasha; escalation policy step 1 (notify Ravi) completed.
Sasha: evicting inference pods on node now. Eviction progress: 8/12 pods evicted. ETA ~90s.
Marta: ping — I'm checking customer-facing error rates & SLOs. Quick glance: small uptick in 500s for two endpoints, spike aligns with OOM window.
Marta: customer impact summary — acme-corp saw ~0.6% error increase and a handful of 5xx timeouts between 03:21–03:24 UTC. Internal canary also showed degraded tail latency. No PII concerns.
Sasha: traffic shifted, pool-42 weight set to 0, pool-41 taking traffic. Reducing lucy batch_size from 8 -> 4 and disabling aggressive kvcache prefetch as temporary measure.
Ravi: applied config change to lucy rollout:```yaml
model: lucy-30b-quant
settings:
  batch_size: 4
  kvcache_prefetch: false
  kvcache_offload: enabled
```
Ravi: monitoring for 5m. If errors persist we'll spin new nodes and migrate replicas.
Sasha: node drain complete, pod restarts on pool-41 started. Observability: cuda mem utilization dropping to ~55% on affected nodes.
Marta: metrics look stable — error rate back to baseline after traffic shift. Notifying support to reach out to impacted ACME contacts with a short note.
Sasha: creating follow-up ticket: #INF-4827 — investigate kvcache leak + prefetch edge-case, attach logs and heapdumps.
Ravi: short term mitigation applied, long term: we'll add prefetch throttling and an OOM backoff in runtime. Assigning to eng-ml.
Marta: handing off to next oncall @Ravi in 20m for monitoring; I'll coordinate customer comms.
Sasha: marking PD as resolved, leaving ticket for postmortem. Great work team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD12345 — RESOLVED (resolved_by Sasha).
